title.value: GAUCHE: A Library for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry

title.quote: GAUCHE: A Library for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry

extractions.description: The paper introduces GAUCHE, an open-source library designed for the application of Gaussian processes in chemistry. GAUCHE provides tools for molecular discovery, chemical reaction optimization, and protein design, with emphasis on Bayesian optimization and uncertainty quantification. It integrates various molecular representations and kernels, enabling advanced probabilistic modeling accessible to chemists and materials scientists.
